_documentation: Owner: r2mlvs14-remaining-assets-and-runtime-integration.md Group61E.1; source-state/occupant mapping from original native owners. This document allocates no station, actor, packet, work clock or SpriteID.

construction.policy: Successful native build installs the whole twelve-cell facility atomically. Placement palette/validity belongs to the native preview; no fictional blueprint, partial building or construction progress.

frame_policy.owner: actual native owners below; no facility animation counter
frame_policy.policy: All logical frames are still aliases within their own state. Retained countdowns choose state only; no GUI time, wall time, frame modulo or artificial earned work.

workshop.owner: Station::launch_operations workshop/service/pod_workshop; one exclusive actual slot

hull_assembly.work: Assembling, exact current owned workshop/home/incarnation, remaining_ticks positive and not paused
hull_assembly.wait: Paused retains the paid unfinished body. Final replacement tick additionally requires original PrepareSpaceReplacement admission; a held handover is not earned work.
hull_assembly.completion: Native remaining_ticks reaches zero once; original hull moves to SurfaceStored, rocket FIFO pad or other craft storage.

probe_service.work: EarthWorkshop location only; exact owned service slot, SurfaceStored, positive valid service_ticks, unpaused and actual role inputs. Orbital Onboard service never operates this Surface workshop.
probe_service.wait: service_paused or actual service admission/input refusal retains original paid countdown and packets; cancellation releases service slot and stores the same hull.
probe_service.completion: Original parts consumed once on final earned native opportunity; original owner grants allowance and releases slot.

pod_assembly.work: Assembling custody, exact original pod_workshop/home/incarnation and owner, remaining_ticks positive and not paused
pod_assembly.wait: Paused or missing current slot preserves shell and remaining work; no second visible shell is authored.
pod_assembly.completion: Original shell enters CenterStored and clears the same exclusive workshop.

workshop.source_parts: Selected workshop geometry; existing window may carry a symbolic admitted-work/wait material in61E.2. No new machinery, hull or cargo.

pad.loading: FIFO head occupies actual Pad only while pad_active is empty; later queue entries occupy Storage. Mere queue membership earns no work.
pad.preparing: Original active rocket, Preparing Surface phase and positive remaining_ticks; native target failure at zero is TargetLost, not extra preparation work.
pad.ascent: Same original rocket owns Ascent and outbound burn receipt. Facility plate/arm have no native actuator pose; source hardware stays fixed.
pad.away: OrbitalDelivery and ReturnRecovery retain reservation without painting a second Surface rocket or a working pad. Actual rocket/payload belong to separate native owners.
pad.wait: Use original SpaceFlightBlock and phase/layer. Holding/HomeLost/PadBusy/TargetLost never advance or recolor an unrelated pad/center.
pad.source_parts: Selected fixed plate/folded arm; preparation/ascent phase differences are separate rocket-source responsibilities, not invented facility motion.

recovery.rocket: ReturnRecovery remains in Space until exact original pad reservation admits Surface Turnaround. Actual Surface custody cell is Recovery, not Pad.
recovery.pod: Actual Descent/Drifting pod and remaining_ticks/blocked stay with its separate shell and native descent job; no facility-owned pod or permanent recovered marker.
recovery.wait: SpaceDescentBlock::TargetLost/StorageFull/CompanyRemoved and original rocket recovery block retain sole cargo/hull ownership.
recovery.source_parts: Selected fixed receiving plate; no native mechanical pose or independent recovery clock. Static aliases preserve the receiving-end marking.

storage.owner: Native station/hub/Vehicle CargoPackets and actual craft/pod custody
storage.source_parts: Selected empty four-bay hardware; static aliases for all facility states. No decorative cargo quantity, second shell or invented loading clock.
storage.policy: Pad FIFO tail, completed craft and stored pods keep their actual native identity/custody. Loading, handling and capacity reasons remain original inventory owners; an empty drawing creates no cargo.

occupant_visibility.surface_hulls: Existing SpaceProduction::Physical requires Hidden for non-InTransit Surface hulls; actual launch transitions retain Hidden through Surface preparation/ascent/turnaround and reveal the same hull in Space.
occupant_visibility.stored_pods: GetSpacePodArtPose returns no scene pose for Assembling/CenterStored/Carried custody; only Drifting/Descent draws the original shell.
occupant_visibility.foreground: Ready/empty source fronts prove only that base.61E.2 must record actual visible-hardware separation or explicit absence against these existing visibility rules. A later Surface actor renderer needs its own foreground acceptance.

selection_boundary: Source mapping only. Future native per-cell selection must resolve exact current owner/incarnation, actual zone and earned/admitted state; a global facility status cannot make unrelated workshop/pad/recovery/storage cells work. Existing GUI owns detailed reasons. No art-local queue, cargo registry or work producer.
